MATERIAL_RISK_BEFORE_SPENDING.not_a_threshold_change: raising n does not move any threshold and cannot manufacture a pass: more episodes reduce false negatives without increasing type-I error. It is also NOT the prohibited extension, which forbids peeking at CONFIRMATION data and then extending. Choosing a larger fixed n before any confirmation episode, on development evidence, is prospective design.
